title: Mistral NeMo Release
summary: Mistral AI announced the release of Mistral NeMo on July 18, 2024, a 12B model built in collaboration with NVIDIA, and released base and instruction-tuned checkpoints under the Apache 2.0 license.
significance: A dated release milestone for an open multilingual Mistral model with a context window of up to 128k tokens.

verification.note: Mistral AI's first-party announcement is dated July 18, 2024 and explicitly says it is releasing Mistral NeMo, a 12B model built in collaboration with NVIDIA, with base and instruction-tuned checkpoints under Apache 2.0 and up to 128k context. Mistral's official model documentation independently records July 18, 2024 and identifier open-mistral-nemo-2407. No development geography, downstream influence, priority claim, unsupported ancestry, causality, or relationship edge is inferred.
